messages:
alexg: Starting a canary dry-run for the Python + TS SDKs in the 2-hour change window. Plan: publish canary dist-tags, run smoke + integration suites, route 10% internal cohort. Pinging @maria_s for release notes cut and @lina for monitoring thresholds.

maria_s: SG. Build artifacts are good on CI. I'm going to tag `canary-dryrun-3551234567` and stage uploads. Py package pushed to TestPyPI staging, npm tarball validated locally. Waiting on deploy-bot to confirm registry perms.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: kicking off publish job for `canary-dryrun-3551234567` -> npm (internal-registry) and pypi-staging. CI run: https://ci.redwood.example/3551234567/logs

lina: Smoke tests queued. Monitoring hooks set for: median latency, 99p latency, memory growth, and token cost. Abort criteria: any signal >5% deviation on core generate endpoints or increase in error-rate >1%.

sam: Dist-tag and uploads done: `npm dist-tag add @redwood/sdk@1.3.2-canary canary-dryrun` and `twine upload --repository-url https://test.pypi.org/legacy/ dist/*` — both returned success on my end.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Publish succeeded for TS package and Py staging upload completed. Checksums: 9f2b4a7... :tada:

alexg: Kicking cohort routing now — feature-flag updated to 10% internal traffic. Dashboard: https://grafana.redwood.example/d/abcd/sdk-canary

tao: Quick note on release notes: we should include a short deprecation mention for the legacy sync client (will not ship in next stable) and call out that this is a dry-run. Draft here: https://docs.redwood.example/drafts/canary-notes

maria_s: Seeing a small median latency increase (~7%) on generate in eu-west-1 for canary traffic. Other regions look stable so far. No obvious error spike yet.

lina: Requesting pause and assessment. Pausing cohort routing — I'll capture traces and flamegraphs. Prepped rollback commands: `npm dist-tag rm @redwood/sdk canary-dryrun` and pypi-staging artifacts can be removed via the staging UI. Also preparing a pinback PR to pin consumers to 1.3.1 for affected envs.

sam: Running rollback steps now — removing dist-tag and flipping feature flag back to 0%.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Rollback complete. `npm dist-tag` removed; traffic reverted to stable. CI logs: https://ci.redwood.example/3551234567/rollback — status: success :white_check_mark:

alexg: Postmortem notes: perf regression introduced by the new bundling pass in SDK build. Action items: revert bundler change on canary branch, run the perf harness locally for eu-west-1 like traffic patterns, and re-schedule a second dry-run Tue 10:00 UTC. I'll update the changelog and a short public note that the stable release is unchanged.

maria_s: Will update release notes to say: "Canary dry-run paused due to a regional perf regression; no stable release changes. Investigating, follow-up scheduled." I'll also add the PR link for the pinback when ready.

alexg: Thanks all — filing a short follow-up doc and assigning owners. :coffee:
